arStrings.szText: Excellent, you appear to be ready. The demon Ae'grom can be found in the Dindai Flats, the demon Laalish lingers near the Blistered Barrens, and the demon Abodian resides in the Forsaken Ascent.
The lairs of each are hidden, but the path you travel is ancient. The way will be revealed to you.
